decision.observation: Car at 4 mph, gear 1, sitting on the left side of the lane with its headlight beam spilling onto the grass verge; the tarmac band is wide here and curves right toward a pale patch at upper-right. Spectators and barrels line both edges, a large blue puddle ahead of the bonnet. Red X lit, all dots dark. Timer frozen at 59:59 with the +5s icon gone from view.
decision.hypothesis: The 0.9s hold kept the car on the lane but it is tracking its left edge while the road curves right; a short throttle-right hold should move it toward the centre of the bend without overshooting.
decision.memory: The dark diagonal pole plus the three red/cream bales on the left verge is a repeatable landmark cluster for this barrel corridor; the road beyond it bends right.
